terms.p.020: Read these terms and our Privacy Policy before you download, install, or use the app. Pay particular attention to the information about backups, replacement restores, permissions, and data cleanup. terms.p.022: You must be authorized to use the devices, WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business accounts, chat backups, and media involved in the migration. You must also be authorized to access, copy, and restore the data. Respect the privacy and legal rights of chat participants, device owners, and other third parties.
terms.p.023: Minors may use the service only when local law and third-party age requirements permit, with any required guardian consent. Do not access another person's device, break into another person's backup, obtain a password or key without authorization, or migrate data that you do not own or have permission to process.
terms.p.025: TransGuru provides chat-backup processing and migration guidance between devices. The current app and website describe the supported directions, message types, account types, and device requirements. Some operations require a data cable, USB OTG, sufficient storage, an available local Wi-Fi connection, and system permissions.
terms.p.026: Compatibility can be affected by Android, iOS, and WhatsApp versions and by device-manufacturer behavior. A successful migration does not mean that every content type, business profile item, sign-in state, or third-party app setting is preserved. The app and website describe known limits.
terms.p.027: Android-to-Android migration is supported. Keep a separate backup before each transfer and verify important chats and media afterward. Interface illustrations, flow summaries, or release notices on the website do not mean that a corresponding build is publicly available for download. Use only a verified release link when one is provided.
terms.p.029: Android-to-iPhone migration does not merge data with existing WhatsApp chats on the destination iPhone. Before you start, save separate backups of any data you need to keep on both devices.
terms.li.030: Before you uninstall, replace, reinstall, or restore anything, read the app and operating-system prompts and confirm the affected device and migration direction.
terms.li.031: Do not delete a backup from the old phone solely because a completion message appears. Check important conversations, media, and files on the destination device before you clean up source data.
terms.li.032: Protect backup passwords and encryption keys. A wrong or lost key may make a backup impossible to decrypt. We cannot recover an unknown key for you.
terms.li.033: Keep enough battery power, storage space, and a stable connection during transfer. An interruption, cancellation, or permission change may require a retry or leave the destination in a state that you must review.
terms.li.034: After migration, follow the cleanup instructions in the Privacy Policy for local backups and intermediate files. Uninstalling the app may not remove data from shared storage.
terms.p.035: These terms do not replace your active confirmation in the app or operating system for an uninstall, data deletion, replacement restore, or similar operation.

Do not bypass user authorization or security confirmations required by the operating system. Use only installation packages, cables, devices, and local networks that you trust.
